n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: A brass bell on a lectern. A runner waits on the stair below for it to ring.

ring.speaker: narrator
ring.text: Ding. Feet on the stair. A soul is shown in, holding its own file as if it might bite.

n2.speaker: narrator
n2.text: The docket tray is empty. The runner looks hopeful, which is unusual for a runner.

new.speaker: narrator
new.text: Three files come up the stair, and a fourth with an APPEAL tag. The work never ends.

none.speaker: narrator
none.text: The bell is still. Nobody is waiting, or somebody already is, or the runners are asleep.
